      ],

      "evidence": "\"The makespan must be at least as large as the completion time of every operation.\" / \"The makespan must be at least 8 hours after the start of Operation 0 and at least 5 hours after the start of Operation 1.\"",
      "options": [
        "Cmax >= s[j,o] + lag for every listed (job, operation) lag",
